newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen moving higher at start.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen moving higher at start.

text.p: A powerful rally in the bond market based on favorable first quarter employment cost index data is expected to take Wall Street stocks higher at the start of trading on Tuesday.
The ECI rose 0.6 percent in the first quarter, much less than the consensus 0.9 percent forecast.
U.S. Treasuries rallied sharply, with the long bond up 1-10/32 to yield 7.00 percent. The seven percent long bond yield is sure to excite equity investors, analysts said.
Analysts said that financial company stocks should resume their rally.
